_about: T0.2 ground truth for the T0.3 ASR bake-off. Sentences authored before recording, so truth is known in advance. record.py sets verified=true per take and writes back any correction.
_ground_truth_rule: text MUST be what was actually said, not what was printed. CER against a sentence the speaker misread measures nothing. If you deviate, answer 'n' at the confirmation prompt and type the actual utterance.
_cer_normalization: Applied at scoring time, not stored here: NFKC, strip ALL whitespace (Japanese is unspaced, so ASR whitespace is noise), strip 、。！？「」,.!?, lowercase ASCII. Then Levenshtein / len(reference), via jiwer for the sub/ins/del split.
_alt_ok_rule: IMPORTANT, affects T0.3's two-stage rule. For code-switched items, a faithful katakana transliteration of an English word (receipt -> レシート) is USABLE as LLM input and must NOT count as a Stage 1 catastrophic failure -- Stage 1 fails only on a dropped English span or genuinely nonsense output. But it IS a CER error against the English-orthography reference in Stage 2. alt_ok lists renderings that pass Stage 1 while still scoring as Stage 2 error. Do not silently normalize them away; that would hide a real difference between models.
_audio: 16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM WAV. One file per id, <id>.wav, alongside this file.

utterances.text: はじめまして、よろしくお願いします。
utterances.covers: formulaic greeting; お- prefix; long polite ending
utterances.romaji: hajimemashite, yoroshiku onegaishimasu

utterances.text: すみません、駅はどこですか。
utterances.gloss: Excuse me, where is the station?
utterances.covers: moraic ん x2; は as topic particle (read wa, not ha)
utterances.romaji: sumimasen, eki wa doko desu ka

utterances.text: これをください。
utterances.covers: shortest utterance in the set; を particle
utterances.romaji: kore o kudasai

utterances.text: これはいくらですか。
utterances.covers: は particle; no kanji at all
utterances.romaji: kore wa ikura desu ka

utterances.text: 日本語が少しわかります。
utterances.covers: kanji compound; が particle; ます form
utterances.romaji: nihongo ga sukoshi wakarimasu

utterances.text: コーヒーを一つお願いします。
utterances.covers: long vowel ー x2 in katakana; counter 一つ
utterances.romaji: koohii o hitotsu onegaishimasu

utterances.text: ちょっと待ってください。
utterances.covers: geminate っ x2 -- the classic Japanese CER failure
utterances.romaji: chotto matte kudasai

utterances.text: 写真を撮ってもいいですか。
utterances.covers: geminate っ; permission form てもいい
utterances.romaji: shashin o totte mo ii desu ka

utterances.text: トイレはどこにありますか。
utterances.covers: katakana loanword; に particle
utterances.romaji: toire wa doko ni arimasu ka

utterances.text: ありがとうございます、また明日。
utterances.covers: long vowel う; 明日 has multiple readings (あした/あす) but one written form
utterances.romaji: arigatou gozaimasu, mata ashita

utterances.text: えーと、how do you say "receipt" in Japanese?
utterances.covers: Japanese filler えーと then an entirely English clause -- worst case for a JA-only model
utterances.romaji: eeto, how do you say "receipt" in Japanese?

utterances.text: すみません、Wi-Fiのpasswordは何ですか。
utterances.gloss: Excuse me, what is the Wi-Fi password?
utterances.covers: English nouns inside a Japanese frame, joined by の
utterances.romaji: sumimasen, Wi-Fi no password wa nan desu ka

utterances.text: This is 美味しい ですね。
utterances.covers: reverse direction -- Japanese embedded in an English frame
utterances.romaji: This is oishii desu ne

utterances.text: 私は engineer です。
utterances.covers: single English noun in an otherwise minimal Japanese sentence
utterances.romaji: watashi wa engineer desu

utterances.text: あの、check please、お願いします。
utterances.covers: filler あの + English phrase + Japanese closing
utterances.romaji: ano, check please, onegaishimasu

utterances.text: 東京 station までいくらですか。
utterances.covers: kanji place name + English noun + まで particle
alt_ok: ステーション for station
utterances.romaji: Toukyou station made ikura desu ka

utterances.text: ごめんなさい、I don't understand、もう一度お願いします。
utterances.gloss: Sorry, I don't understand, once more please.
utterances.covers: full English clause between two Japanese ones; tests whether the middle is dropped
utterances.romaji: gomennasai, I don't understand, mou ichido onegaishimasu

utterances.text: Can I pay with カード ですか。
utterances.covers: katakana inside an English frame -- deliberately ungrammatical, as a real beginner would say it
utterances.romaji: Can I pay with kaado desu ka

utterances.text: えっと、vegetarian の menu ありますか。
utterances.gloss: Um, is there a vegetarian menu?
utterances.covers: filler えっと (geminate) + two English nouns joined by の
alt_ok: ベジタリアン for vegetarian
utterances.romaji: etto, vegetarian no menu arimasu ka

utterances.text: 明日 の morning、七時に来ます。
utterances.gloss: Tomorrow morning, I will come at seven.
utterances.covers: kanji + English noun + time counter 七時
utterances.romaji: ashita no morning, shichi-ji ni kimasu

_reading_aid: romaji is what the speaker reads aloud. The Japanese script in `text` is the CER reference and is shown only for context. gloss is NEVER displayed during recording -- an earlier version displayed it and the beginner speaker read the English instead, invalidating the whole corpus.
